en: Color image with a white border showing a wintry park scene. A woman in a long fur coat stands on a snow-covered path with a small shaggy dog beside her. Bare trees dusted with snow fill the background. On the right side, a classic upright bicycle with a front basket is parked by the low wall that borders the path. The overall mood is quiet and contemplative, with soft winter light.
